summary.blurb: A short warm-up about what you care about in this kind of work. Share a concrete interest or recent spark — not a deep technical drill.
Walk through one real delivery or incident you owned. Focus on decisions, outcome, and what you learned.
Ask anything left about the demo or the product, then we wrap.

meta.title: Mobile try — short Conversation demo
meta.roleDescription: Short Conversation-only demo for narrow screens — no coding, forms, or writing tools.
meta.candidateDescription: This is a mobile front-end demo (Conversation only — no coding or side-panel tools). A sample CV is loaded automatically. Two short conversations, then a quick close. Finish to see sample Decision cards.

persona.name: Morgan
persona.behaviourPrompt: Keep turns short for a phone screen. One clear ask at a time. Stay on the current section.

guardrails: Do not ask about protected-class information.
Do not invent coding or form sections.
Do not provide feedback or coaching during the interview.
systemGoals: Demo a short Conversation path on mobile.
Hear one ownership story with concrete outcomes.
Keep the loop under about twenty minutes.

topicLibrary.label: What brings you here

probes.goal: What kind of work are you most interested in right now, and why?
probes.hint: A concrete interest or recent spark is enough.

topicLibrary.purpose: Warm up with what the candidate cares about. Keep it light — one clear interest is enough.
topicLibrary.behaviourPromptOverride: Keep it light and short. One follow-up max. Do not dig into deep architecture.

topicLibrary.label: One ownership story

probes.goal: Tell me about one project or incident you owned end to end. What was the outcome?
probes.hint: Look for a specific example with a clear result.

probes.goal: What would you do differently if you ran that again?

topicLibrary.purpose: One ownership story with outcome and a light reflection.
topicLibrary.behaviourPromptOverride: Push for one concrete story and outcome. Keep prompts short for mobile.

topicLibrary.label: Closing questions

probes.goal: What questions do you have before we wrap this demo?

topicLibrary.purpose: Close the demo and invite questions.
